title: POST /internal/v1/assessments 200 response (private)
description: Detector -> gateway. An assessment and the evidence for it, with no decision attached. There is deliberately no confidence number: an LLM-invented probability is not calibrated and must not be presented as if it were.

prompt_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the prompt that produced this assessment. A version name alone cannot prove which bytes ran.

diagnostics.description: Non-authoritative, for evaluation and cost accounting. Every field is optional: unknown provider usage is ABSENT, never zero, because reporting an unknown token count as 0 would quietly understate cost. There is deliberately no confidence field - an LLM-invented probability is not calibrated and must not be rendered as though it were.

attempts.description: Provider requests made for this assessment, including retries. Bounds what the scan actually cost.

max_tokens.description: Output ceiling the request was made with. Part of the inference settings a result must be attributable to.
